TEXT: The next morning,

I went down the stairs and came across Kirino at 
the foyer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *yawn*... Mornin'.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Tch... Do you plan on sleeping forever just because 
it's summer break?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You do know that everyone's coming by today?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll get ready now, I'll make it before they get here.

Kirino gestured her index finger, as if saying "over 
here".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?

Following her directions, I look in the living room 
and...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Oh my, good morning... Senpai. You sure woke up 
late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuroneko? You're here really early.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Yes, I can't just leave that woman alone to handle 
all the preparations.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
You don't want to eat charcoal cookies again, do 
you?
What is she talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Never mind. First of all, can you do something 
about your appearance?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh yeah, sorry.

I rustled the messy bed hair from my sleep and 
rushed towards the washroom.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm done changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Okay, now get out of here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh!
Every time this girl says something, it surprises me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...W-What do you mean? Are you planning on leaving 
me out and having fun without me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Don't look at me like a stray dog.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
That's not what I mean, I'm telling you to kill some 
time with Saori outside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Good grief, this woman is terrible at explaining 
things to others.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Senpai, please listen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: We have prepared a sideshow, just for today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sideshow?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Yes... that's right. An enjoyable and fun yet secretive 
sideshow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That being the case, could you please wait outside 
until we're finished preparing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...What are you, my older sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Heh... You were just so pitiful-looking, so I talked like 
how I would to my little sisters.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That so? I want to be your little brother now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I don't need such a big little brother.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Come on now, Saori will arrive anytime now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hurry up and get out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah yeah, I got it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I'll call you when we're ready, so please kill some 
time somewhere with Saori when she gets here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Got it.
